hooks.command:
cat <<'EOF'
After-compaction rules of the copilot-plugin-cc ticket workflow.

If this session does not run workflow-auto, workflow-manual or a step skill that one of them calls, do nothing.

If the session runs the workflow, the summary can have dropped rules. Do this before you go on with the current step or do anything else in the workflow:

First, if .claude/skills/workflow-common/RELEASE.md does not exist in the current checkout, the checkout is from before the workflow reference was split. Before you read anything by rule 1: git status --porcelain must print nothing, git fetch origin must work, and git merge origin/main must end without a conflict (on a conflict, run git merge --abort). If one of these fails, or the file is still missing, stop and report.

1. Read again .claude/skills/workflow-common/REFERENCE.md, the files next to it that the step you are on names (REVIEW-LOOP.md, PR-REVIEW-LOOP.md, RELEASE.md, BUG-TRIAGE.md), the SKILL.md of the skill whose step you are on, and the SKILL.md of each workflow skill that called it (.claude/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md, where the repo has one). For a step skill that workflow-manual called, that includes .claude/skills/workflow-manual/SKILL.md. Under workflow-auto, it always includes .claude/skills/workflow-auto/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/workflow-manual/SKILL.md and .claude/skills/workflow-common/RELEASE.md.
2. Read again the scratchpad files that the current step names. Under workflow-auto, that always includes <scratchpad>/workflow-auto-report.md.
3. Record a check as run only when you ran it after this compaction, or when the summary quotes its output. A check is one of the commands in REFERENCE.md "Commands", a reviewer or a Spec Kit check. A result that the summary only restates, such as "clean" or "no findings", is not its output: run the check again. Before you run a check again, read the file that holds its rules: BUG-TRIAGE.md for a Spec Kit bug check, REVIEW-LOOP.md or PR-REVIEW-LOOP.md for a reviewer. When /speckit-bug-test then asks to overwrite test.md, confirm it. For a release run step, the release run record is the proof, not the summary: do not run a step again because of the summary, and go on from the record as "Record" under "Release run" in RELEASE.md says.
EOF
